lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in approximately five identifiable vertical columns within the primary field of view, with the largest and brightest spots occupying the central horizontal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where blobs often serve as focal nodes within the bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized distribution of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than those found on the lateral flank.
